GizmondoDroid v0.1 — first HLE build.

- Runs Gizmondo (Windows CE ARM) .exe homebrew directly; no firmware needed.
- Game library from /sdcard/GizmondoDroid (appears to programs as \Storage Card).
- On-screen buttons, controller mapping, screen filters, in-game menu, in-app updater.
- Not yet: save states, original firmware boot (planned, user-supplied key).
- Note: this build is signed with the debug key until a release keystore is configured.
